name: Rubric evaluators
summary: Foundry-native rubric evaluators (preview) with a BYOM-routed LLM-as-judge.
description: Rubric evaluators let you score agent/model responses against custom weighted criteria using an LLM as the judge. The judge model is picked per-rubric (either auto-generated or manually configured). BYOM question: does the rubric evaluator accept a `{conn}/{model}` prefix for the judge, and does the resulting judge call route through the AI Gateway?
notes:
Not yet probed against Foundry because the flow requires REST `create-rubric-evaluator` plus `create-evaluation-run`. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/concepts/evaluation-evaluators/rubric-evaluators.

The preview surface is mostly portal-driven. Docs recommend judges `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.4`, or `gpt-5.4-mini`; avoid `gpt-4o-mini` as judge.
